claim_zh_cn: 粉床细粉迁移引发微观通道效应时，局部过萃会导致中段甜感中断，并在余韵中引入涩感与杂味。
claim_en: When fines migrate and open micro-channels in the bed, local over-extraction breaks the mid-palate sweetness and brings astringency and off-notes into the finish.
use_note: Extraction-physics explanations paraphrased for the notes on channeling and extraction yield; cited with author attribution.
claim_zh_cn_alt: 手冲时若细粉在粉床里迁移、形成小通道，局部会过萃：中段的甜感断开，余韵多出涩与杂。
claim_en_alt: In a pour-over, fines that migrate and open small channels in the bed over-extract locally: the mid-palate sweetness breaks and the finish picks up astringency and off-notes.

claim_zh_cn: 浅烘手冲时，萃取率落在合适区间才有饱满的中段甜感；萃取率不足则酸而空，过高则涩。
claim_en: For light roasts on pour-over, mid-palate sweetness fills in only inside the right extraction-yield window; under-extraction reads sour and hollow, over-extraction astringent.
use_note: Extraction-physics explanations paraphrased for the notes on channeling and extraction yield; cited with author attribution.
claim_zh_cn_alt: 浅烘用手冲，甜感是否饱满取决于萃取率：偏低时酸而单薄，偏高时发涩。
claim_en_alt: With a light roast on pour-over, whether the sweetness fills in depends on extraction yield: too low reads sour and thin, too high turns astringent.

claim_en: Medium-dark espresso is more sensitive to channeling under pressure: an uneven puck shows under-extracted sourness and over-extracted bitterness at once.
use_note: Extraction-physics explanations paraphrased for the notes on channeling and extraction yield; cited with author attribution.
claim_zh_cn_alt: 中深烘做意式时，粉饼稍不均匀就会同时出现欠萃的酸和过萃的苦，因为高压放大了通道效应。
claim_en_alt: Medium-dark espresso shows both under-extracted sourness and over-extracted bitterness as soon as the puck is uneven, because pressure amplifies channeling.
